name: Takashi
source:
A classmate and very good friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c75867]Yuka[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c75868]Youko[/url]. Yuka and him hope to be in the same next school they will attend. 

Yuka seems to have a crush on him and it seems that "crush" is reciprocal. [spoiler]However, with time and after her [url=https://vndb.org/c76834]older brother[/url] is shown to her that he really and sincerely loved her (in a way too direct) as a woman, she realizes that she is not in love with Takashi and makes him understand that there will never be more than friendship between them.[/spoiler]
